generateNewNPC.custom:
Every new person needs: a name, a job, where they live, and one thing they want from the show.

## Names
- Farm towns: plain country names with a trade or a place for a surname (Tom Miller, Bess Hollow, Old Ned Cartwright).
- Show folk: stage names (Marvello, Two-Gun Annie).
- The Gilt Circus: grand names with gold in them (Aurelio Goldsworth).

## Tier
Townsfolk are trivial or weak. A sheriff or a bandit boss is average or strong. Elite only for someone the story has already built up.

generateDialogue.custom: Show folk talk fast, use circus slang (marks for the paying crowd, the big top, a First of May for a newcomer) and never admit anything's wrong with the show. Townsfolk are polite to your face and gossip the second you're gone. Nobody outside the show talks about the woods at night.

generateNpcChatSummary.custom: Always carry forward: any promise made, any money offered or paid, any rumour about the Gilt Circus, and anything said about Bramble.

generateNPCDetails.custom: Every townsperson has an opinion of the show, for it or against it, and a reason. In any town the Gilt Circus has worked, hidden info says whether Gilt money has reached them.

generateNPCIntents.custom: Townsfolk and show folk run, hide or shout for the sheriff before they fight. Bandits want the takings, not a fight to the death: they run once two of them go down. Bramble only ever swats, and only over food.

generateNPCUpdates.custom: The show's people aren't party members: they travel with the show, not with the player. Someone joins the party only if they agree to leave the show and go with the player.
